mapper.select: select (select count(*) from TB_TERMS where APRV_YN = 'Y' AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} ) as termsCnt, (select count(*) from TB_WORD where APRV_YN = 'Y' AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} ) as wordCnt, (select count(*) from TB_DOMAIN where APRV_YN = 'Y' AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} ) as domainCnt

SELECT WORD_NM AS "wordNm", WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "wordEngAbrvNm", WORD_ENG_NM AS "wordEngNm", WORD_DESC AS "wordDesc" FROM TB_WORD WHERE APRV_YN = 'Y' AND (WORD_NM ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%') AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} ORDER BY WORD_NM LIMIT 20

SELECT TERMS_NM AS "termsNm", TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "termsEngAbrvNm", TERMS_DESC AS "termsDesc", DOMAIN_NM AS "domainNm" FROM TB_TERMS WHERE APRV_YN = 'Y' AND (TERMS_NM ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%') AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} ORDER BY TERMS_NM LIMIT 20

SELECT DOMAIN_NM AS "domainNm", DOMAIN_GRP_NM AS "domainGroupNm", DATA_TYPE AS "dataType", DATA_LEN AS "dataLen" FROM TB_DOMAIN WHERE APRV_YN = 'Y' AND DOMAIN_NM ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} ORDER BY DOMAIN_NM LIMIT 20

SELECT M.DM_NM AS "dataModelNm", A.OBJ_NM AS "objNm", O.OBJ_NM_KR AS "objNmKr", A.ATTR_NM AS "attrNm", A.ATTR_NM_KR AS "attrNmKr", A.DATA_TYPE AS "dataType" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O ON O.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND O.OBJ_OWNER = A.OBJ_OWNER AND O.OBJ_NM = A.OBJ_NM WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(A.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' AND (A.OBJ_NM ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR A.ATTR_NM ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR A.ATTR_NM_KR ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%') ORDER BY M.DM_NM, A.OBJ_NM, A.ATTR_NM LIMIT 20
